controlling_failure_rules: Failure of the exact locked native LayerCake certificates or their bound execution invariants is LAYERCAKE_HOST_REGRESSION.
Failure of ABI labeling, segregation, source qualification, provenance, accounting, or artifact adequacy before LayerCake invocation is ABI_EXTRACTION_FAILURE.
Failure of bit-exact native payload installation, canonical ABI identity, sparse dispatch, or persistent state is ABI_LAYERCAKE_INTEGRATION_FAILURE when the direct native execution remains valid.
An installed candidate quality failure on a scope that no same-topology known-good or oracle payload passes is ABI_ACQUISITION_OR_EXPANDED_LAYERCAKE_HOST_CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED.
A same-topology oracle pass followed by an ABI candidate quality failure localizes the failure to ABI_ACQUISITION_OR_INTEGRATION_QUALITY.
A same integrated ABI candidate passing the quality and performance gates directly proves the end-to-end claim and does not need to inherit any native metric.
prohibited_claims: Do not call V72-V75 broad natural-English failures ABI-only.
Do not call the V79 expanded-scope failure a regression of the locked Phase 2 proof.
Do not borrow locked LayerCake speed or quality metrics for an ABI candidate.
Do not resume expensive ABI extraction or payload sweeps until the same-topology direct-target oracle resolves expanded host capacity.
